newsitem.title: USA: Premiere says to sell $150 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Premiere says to sell $150 mln in notes.

text.p: Premiere Technologies said Thursday it will sell $150 million in 5 3/4 percent convertible subordinated notes.
The company said it has granted the initial purchasers of the notes a 30-day option to buy up to an additional $22.5 million of notes to cover over-allotments, if any.
The offering for the notes is expected to close June 30. They are due July 1, 20004.
The notes, which are non-callable for three years, will be convertible into common stock of the company at a conversion price of $33 per share.
The notes will be convertible into a total of about 4,545,455 shares of common stock of the company, or 5,227,273 shares if the initial purchasers' over-allotment option is exercised in full.
The company said it plans to use the proceeds of the offering for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures and working capital.
It may also use a portion of the proceeds to acquire complementary business products and techonologies.
